name: Metamagic Rod, Merciful
body:
Aura strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

Price varies by specific type:

Lesser merciful metamagic rod 1,500 gp
Merciful metamagic rod 5,500 gp
Greater merciful metamagic rod 12,250

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that deal nonlethal damage as though using the Merciful Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Merciful Spell

Cost varies by specific type:

Lesser merciful metamagic rod 750 gp
Merciful metamagic rod 2,750 gp
Greater merciful metamagic rod 6,125 gp
